training_scope.allowed: 55 train-fit quality cases plus both grouped long requests
training_scope.precision_diagnostic: five train-precision-diagnostic cases; excluded from fitting
training_scope.test: 20 cases opened exactly once after probe rank, weights, transforms, baselines, budgets, K values, and scorer are frozen

target_formula: For source row (request,layer,t), the K target is the 256-way Boolean union of exact selected expert IDs at the same request and layer for positions t+1 through t+K. Only K in {2,4,8}; any gap, duplicate position, layer/request crossing, duplicate selected ID, or incomplete window is FAIL.

metrics.full_set_coverage: indicator(true union is a subset of predicted top-B)
metrics.headline_aggregation: arithmetic mean within each request, then unweighted arithmetic mean across test requests
metrics.uncertainty: paired bootstrap over the 20 test requests using the frozen training seed; 10000 resamples

baselines: per-layer frequency prior trained only on allowed training rows

probe_grid.features: gate-input hidden feature plus causal recent selected-expert history
probe_grid.selection: train-only grouped cross-validation; no calibration or test access

decision_rule: Freeze the train-CV-selected probe and all baselines before opening test. Continue the probe to P2 only if its paired 95% lower bound over frequency is positive for the primary K=4,budget=32 macro-request recall and its point recall exceeds frequency for all nine K/budget cells. If frequency is not beaten, stop. If MTP dominates at equal end-to-end cost, fold the probe into the MTP oracle rather than ship a separate mechanism.
mandatory_failures: training input contains a precision-diagnostic, calibration, or test request
future window crosses request/layer boundary or a position gap
missing, duplicate, reordered, nonfinite, or malformed array
ranking contains duplicate or out-of-range expert IDs
test is opened before candidate freeze
macro-request result is replaced by event weighting
scorer, source, split, seed, or model artifact hash differs
